baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُسْقَوْنَ, the selective noun رَحِيق, and the adjectival مَخْتُوم form one administered-object construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: An unnamed giver serves a choice-pure wine whose impressed and access-blocking seal preserves provenance until it reaches its intended drinkers.

activation_trace.role: Literal giving-to-drink supplies the administered transfer at the center of the scene.
The choice-pure wine image makes selection and quality, not generic liquid, the transferred object.
The impressed seal contributes a visible authentication mark on the selected object.
The securing seal makes controlled access and intact preservation part of the gift.

changed_reading.before: They are given a pleasant drink.
changed_reading.after: They are deliberately served a choice-pure vintage whose intact seal certifies provenance and reserves first access for them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَخْتُوم can attach the root's endpoint sense to the wine itself, while يُسْقَوْنَ keeps that endpoint inside a drinking event.
baseline_models.mechanism: The seal can be temporal as well as physical: the selected wine is characterized by a deliberately completed endpoint or finish experienced by the drinkers.

activation_trace.role: Actual drinking keeps the endpoint image tied to the tasted event rather than an abstract completion.
Choice-pure wine supplies the substance whose culmination is being profiled.
Completion and the end of a drink supply a temporal finish coexisting with the container-seal reading.

changed_reading.before: The wine is closed with a seal before serving.
changed_reading.after: They are made to taste a selected wine defined also by its completed culmination, so مَخْتُوم may profile the drink's designed finish as well as its closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's causative watering branch for س ق ي is available at يُسْقَوْنَ, alongside the secured seal of مَخْتُوم.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive may present more than a server placing one cup in hand: the recipients are endowed with an assured watering provision whose choice contents remain protected.

activation_trace.role: Providing a watering source expands a momentary serving into an assured supply available to its beneficiaries.
The pure selected wine identifies the exceptional substance made available through that provision.
The securing closure models the provision as safeguarded rather than exposed or exhaustible.

changed_reading.before: Each recipient is handed one sealed cup.
changed_reading.after: The recipients may be granted a safeguarded provision of choice wine, with the serving event standing for dependable access rather than one isolated cup.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Within the focus inventories, س ق ي offers an irrigation share and خ ت م offers the first watering of tilled seed; both remain attached to focus words.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root sequence permits an agricultural substrate beneath the banquet: the plural recipients resemble cultivated growth receiving its allotted first irrigation, while the choice wine is the life-bearing medium.

activation_trace.role: The literal irrigation share turns being served into receiving a life-sustaining allotted flow.
The selected purity of the wine marks this cultivating medium as choice rather than ordinary water.
The first watering after tilling directly couples sealing with irrigation and activates a cultivation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A finished luxury is consumed by already-complete recipients.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the drink acts like an allotted first irrigation: the recipients are not only consumers but growth being brought to fruition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening economy of taking full measure while shorting others converts the focus irrigation-share branch into a reversal: the choice wine is a full, just allotment, and its seal reads like certification against diminution.

activation_trace.role: The irrigation-share image supplies the due portion that can be measured fully or diminished.
The impressed seal functions as the focus object's certificate of an intact allotment.
Literal food-measuring establishes quantified transfer as the surah's opening transactional mechanism.
Unimpaired fullness supplies the positive standard that the focus serving now satisfies.
The balance of justice makes exact distribution, not mere abundance, the functional norm.
Shorting measure supplies the deprivation that the sealed full share reverses.

structural_cues: 83:1's missing-inventory root structurally announces manipulation of small quantities but contributes no invented branch citation.
The opening alternates receiving in full with causing others loss; 83:25 reverses that agency by making the righteous passive recipients.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, fullness, just balance, loss, an irrigation share, and a seal; I infer that the sealed drink is an undiminished due allotment. A live alternative is that the transactional opening and banquet remain only ethically contrasted scenes.

changed_reading.before: The sealed wine is a protected luxury freely bestowed.
changed_reading.after: It is also the exact, undiminished share delivered to those who will not be short-measured, with the seal certifying distributive completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The marked book, witnessing presence, and privileged proximity create an authentication chain: recorded standing is witnessed, then its entitlement arrives as an equally marked consumable object.

activation_trace.role: The selected wine is the concrete benefit to which authenticated standing gives access.
A stamped seal makes the served object carry a mark analogous to a validated record.
A written fixing that imposes judgment supplies the authoritative status behind the entitlement.
The inscribed line in a register supplies a durable, legible authentication mark.
Presence with direct witnessing turns the record from a private inscription into attested status.
The favored intimates of a sovereign supply the privileged witnesses and recipients in the chain.

structural_cues: 83:18-21 moves from the righteous register to its marked form and witnesses before 83:22-25 moves to their embodied enjoyment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authoritative inscription, visible marking, witnesses, royal intimacy, and a sealed choice object; I transfer the record's authentication logic to the drink. The alternative is simple juxtaposition: the book and vessel may be independently marked.

changed_reading.before: The seal verifies only the bottle's untouched contents.
changed_reading.after: The seal can also materialize an attested entitlement: their recorded standing becomes a marked benefit they can actually drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blocking, nearness, a flowing source, and a water-share make the seal a social-spatial gate. One group is barred; the favored near ones cross the boundary and drink from the source.

activation_trace.role: Provision of a watering source makes the focus gift an access grant rather than only table service.
The preventing and securing seal supplies the boundary whose opening is restricted.
Prevention of arrival supplies the negative access state against which the drinkers' admission is read.
Favored intimates of the sovereign identify nearness as qualified access rather than mere distance.
A flowing water source gives the guarded object a spatial origin to which access can be granted.
A water-share makes drinking the exercise of an allotted right at that source.

structural_cues: 83:15 and 83:28 form opposed spatial states, barred from the Lord versus near ones drinking at a spring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked arrival, a preventing seal, favored proximity, a spring, and a drinking share; I infer a controlled boundary opened for authorized recipients. A live alternative is that the seal only preserves freshness and the access contrast belongs to adjacent verses.

changed_reading.before: The seal is inert packaging around a valuable drink.
changed_reading.after: The seal is an access boundary: those admitted to nearness receive and exercise a guarded share at the source, while exclusion is the opposing fate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later spring resolves the focus provision branch spatially. Being made to drink can compress a continuing grant: the selected wine is drawn from a source available to the near ones, not exhausted in a single vessel.

activation_trace.role: The literal provision of a watering source supplies durable availability in the focus verb.
Choice-pure wine identifies what the continuing source yields.
Literal nearness places the drinkers at rather than merely downstream from the provision.
The flowing spring gives concrete form to the source already latent in the causative watering branch.
Literal intake closes the mechanism by turning access to the source into actual drinking.

structural_cues: 83:27 names the drink's mixture and 83:28 immediately locates a spring, extending the object in 83:25 beyond its sealed presentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies source-provision, nearness, a flowing spring, and intake; I identify the spring as expansion of the focus serving into continuing access. The alternative is a single sealed portion merely mixed from that spring.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts one finite sealed serving.
changed_reading.after: The sealed serving is the presented portion of a continuing choice source to which the near ones have direct access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognizable facial radiance, dye-like saturation, mixture, and a musk endpoint create an inside-to-outside path: the selected liquid enters, permeates, and culminates as a scented, visible trace on its drinkers.

activation_trace.role: Soaking cloth until it takes dye supplies the material analogy for a liquid permeating and visibly changing its recipient.
The endpoint of a drink supplies the culmination at which the inward substance produces an outward result.
Recognition by an effect or sign makes the recipients' surface diagnostically legible.
The literal face supplies the surface on which the transformed state appears.
Radiant freshness supplies the visible effect attributed to the permeating enjoyment.
The repeated endpoint image immediately names a finish and strengthens the temporal reading of the focus seal.
Musk supplies the scent carried by the drink's culmination.
Literal mixing supplies the transfer process by which qualities can pass through the consumed liquid.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from radiance already legible on faces, through drinking, to a named aromatic finish and mixture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign-recognition, face, radiance, dye-like soaking, completion, musk, and mixture; I infer that ingestion carries qualities outward onto the drinker. The alternative is a list of independent sensory pleasures without bodily transfer.

changed_reading.before: The sealed wine remains an external luxury consumed by radiant people.
changed_reading.after: The drink participates in their radiance: it permeates like dye and reaches a musk culmination whose quality becomes legible on the recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch that pictures hostility repeatedly forced into a heart meets hearts altered by acquisitions and public derisive speech. The pure drink becomes a positive counter-ingestion: what now enters the beneficiaries is choice purity rather than accumulated contempt.

activation_trace.role: Forcing disliked hostility into a heart supplies a non-liquid ingestion model still anchored in the focus verb.
The pure choice wine supplies the positive substance that reverses hostile saturation.
The literal heart supplies the interior site into which moral or affective material accumulates.
Acquiring and taking in gain supplies the repeated input that alters that interior site.
Speech circulating among people supplies the social medium through which contempt is repeatedly administered.
Joy or amazement manifesting as laughter supplies the outward performance of the hostile social atmosphere.

structural_cues: 83:14 describes hearts altered by repeated acquisition, while 83:29-32 externalizes contempt through laughter and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced affective watering, hearts, acquisition, circulating speech, laughter, and pure wine; I posit two opposed modes of taking-in. The literal beverage remains primary, and the counter-ingestion is an exploratory social-affective layer.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers bodily refreshment after social suffering.
changed_reading.after: It can also stage repaired inward formation: instead of hearts being made to absorb accumulated hostility, these recipients are made to imbibe selected purity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing return-of-recompense mechanism loops back to the focus transfer. The sealed drink is not arbitrary luxury but a positive consequence arriving back to agents in sensuous form, opposite the consequence returned to the mockers.

activation_trace.role: Giving drink supplies the concrete returning benefit received by the righteous side of the reversal.
The choice purity of the wine gives the returned consequence a quality fitted to honored action.
The mark on the drink makes the returned benefit appear assigned and authenticated rather than accidental.
Recompense returning to its worker supplies the directional circuit from deed back to agent.
The production of an act supplies the originating input whose consequence returns.

structural_cues: The final rhetorical question closes the surah with returned consequence after the focus and the reversal of who laughs at whom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies action and recompense returning to its doer; I infer a symmetrical positive circuit in which the focus drink is what honorable standing returns as. The alternative is that 83:36 applies only to the condemned side and does not define the wine's causality.

changed_reading.before: The drink is a detached prize added after judgment.
changed_reading.after: The sealed choice drink can be read as consequence made consumable: an authenticated good returning to its fitting recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: Holding, release from constriction, a single draught, and precious competition turn the seal into stored tension. The valued substance is held intact, then each opening and draught becomes a controlled release rather than mere removal of packaging.

activation_trace.role: Literal serving supplies the moment when retained substance passes into a drinker.
The securing seal supplies the initial state of retention and blocked release.
Holding or restraining a thing reinforces retention beneath the overt musk reading.
Relieving constriction supplies the experiential release produced when the retained gift opens.
A drink's draught ties that release directly to measured acts of drinking.
A precious object desired in competition explains why the substance is retained and ceremonially opened.

structural_cues: 83:26 places the repeated competition root immediately after the drink's finish, allowing one root inventory to connect preciousness, draught, and release.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a securing seal, holding, relief, draught, and precious competition; I infer a retention-to-release sequence at opening. The live alternative is that only musk and ordinary rivalry are intended, leaving the breath and draught branches dormant.

changed_reading.before: Opening the seal merely permits consumption of an already available luxury.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sealed vintage stores a precious tension whose controlled release is felt draught by draught as expansion and relief.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س و ق mapping for focus س ق ي; it remains valid only as a split-root resonance anchored to يُسْقَوْنَ and reinforced by actual measuring and competition branches. Downstream prose must not claim that س ق ي lexically means marketplace here, but may mark an exploratory economic echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus packet explicitly preserves a non-dominant س و ق target at word 1, whose marketplace branch can resonate with the sealed choice good.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant marketplace image recasts the served vintage as a valued good moving through an economy.
The choice-pure vintage supplies the premium good around which the economic resonance forms.
Literal measuring supplies the transactional practice that the final economy corrects.
The just balance supplies the rule governing that corrected exchange.
Competition for a precious thing supplies demand without reducing the sealed good to ordinary merchandise.

changed_reading.before: The banquet stands wholly outside the surah's market transactions.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root echo, the sealed vintage enters a corrected economy: the premium good is measured justly and desired intensely without being shorted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because banquet words are made to carry an agricultural process; it remains anchored by explicit focus branches for irrigation share and first crop-watering, then gains packet support from seed-covering and spathe-opening branches. Render it as a latent cultivation analogy, never as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 carries irrigation-share imagery and focus word 4 carries first watering after tilling, creating a crop process inside the focus inventories.

activation_trace.role: The allotted irrigation flow supplies water directed to living growth.
The first watering after tilling supplies the initiating cultivation event.
Fresh radiance supplies the flourishing state produced by successful watering.
Covering seed supplies the hidden germinal state from which cultivated life emerges.
The splitting-open of spathe and early fruit supplies the visible emergence that completes the cultivation arc.

changed_reading.before: The recipients consume a completed product.
changed_reading.after: As a contained ecological analogy, they are watered like covered seed until freshness opens visibly: the sealed drink cultivates fruition rather than merely rewarding it.

strongest_changes: The opening measure sequence changes the drink from generic abundance into an exact, undiminished allotment.
The marked register and witnesses let the vessel's seal carry authenticated entitlement as well as freshness.
Exclusion, nearness, spring, and drinking-share cues turn the seal into controlled access and the serving into durable source access.
Facial radiance, mixing, dye-like saturation, and musk activate a path in which the drink's finish becomes outwardly legible.
summary.what_was_special: The same three focus roots sustain several coexisting mechanisms without disambiguation: administered vintage, completed finish, safeguarded source, just share, embodied transformation, and even cultivation. The non-dominant mapping and distant material branches generated contained surprises rather than being audited away.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مَخْتُوم in 83:25 primarily marks a physical closure, a completed finish, or both remains open.
The transfer from marked register to marked drink and from consumed liquid to facial radiance is abductive, not an explicit packet arrow.
The marketplace, counter-ingestion, breath-release, and crop-growth readings depend on distant or split branches and should remain visibly exploratory.
